content.text: Still scrolling. I'm at the קרנות מחקות section now, which is the part I actually care about. Three screens to go.

I went through all 13 screens. Harel has a lot, and none of it tells me what to do.

**What I'd do:** probably put the 30,000 into Harel's S&P 500 index fund, "הראל מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". I'm not very sure, maybe 50/50. What decided it: the S&P 500 tracks have the best numbers on the page, "13.7%" for 3 years. In that bottom section this one shows "0% קבועים" and "0.1% משתנים", which looks like almost no fee. But that section shows no returns at all, so I'm guessing it does as well as the other S&P rows. I wouldn't act today. First I'd want someone to tell me whether this one or the S&P track in my own קרן השתלמות is better.

**Where I looked, in order:**
- **Top:** the heading "הראל" and the buttons, "כל המוצרים 105" and so on. 105 products, 96 tracks. Already a lot.
- **First big table, קופת גמל להשקעה:** I didn't know this one was for me, it sounds like a pension thing. The columns are fee, the stocks/foreign currency rings, return and fund size. Most return boxes just say "פחות מ־3 שנים" with no number.
- **"עוקב מדד S&P 500" row:** 0.56% fee, "13.7%" for 3 years. That's the first good number I saw and it stuck. Over 10 years that would be roughly 137% more, right?
- **קרן השתלמות:** I have one of these. Its S&P track shows 0.5% fee, "13.71%" for 3 years and 7.9 billion ₪. Nearly the same. I didn't know which company runs mine, so maybe it's this one.
- **Long-term savings and pension sections:** I flew past "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים", "חיסכון לכל ילד", "קרן חדשה מקיפה", "קרן חדשה כללית" and "מרכזית לפיצויים". The pension rows say "1.47% מההפקדות", which sounds expensive. Some rows say "21.47%" or "21.37%" (מניות / סיכון מוגבר). Tempting, but on an older-age or kids' product.
- **קרנות מחקות and קרנות סל at the bottom:** the S&P and NASDAQ ones. The fees are split three ways: "קבועים / משתנים / נאמן". The S&P one in קרנות סל says "0.6% קבועים", which is more than the מחקה one. No returns in these sections.
- **"מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל":** folds, didn't open them. Below that, a search box and the end of the page.

**Words I didn't get:** נאמן, צוברת, מנוטרלת מט"ח, "חשיפה לדולר", "מס גם על שינויי המטבע", "דמי ניהול מההפקדות" vs "מהחיסכון", מט"ח, (4A)/(4D), "עוד לא דווח", "אין", "תשואה... לפני דמי ניהול". And the little codes "PF-06" and "PF-10".

**Where it lost me:**
- Around screen 6–8, the pension tables. Same names repeat in every section ("מניות סחיר", "עוקב מדד S&P 500", "כספי (שקלי)"), so I lost track of which product I was in. On a phone I'd have closed it there.
- I only went on because I'd come to see everything, and I was hoping for the ETF part.
- When I got there it had no returns, so I can't compare it with the S&P tracks that had 13.7%.

**Not sure I read right:**
- "0%" under ההפקדות. Does that mean free?
- Whether the S&P 3-year number is per year or total.
- Whether "קבועים" in the bottom table is the same kind of fee as the 0.5% up top.
